## Technical Architecture Philosophy
Transitioning from traditional rule-based SOC monitoring to AI-Augmented architectures.
- **Threat Detection**: Moved from static regex rules to ensemble ML classification with 97% accuracy.
- **Alert Explainability**: Transitioned from black-box logs to SHAP feature contribution values.
- **Incident Reporting**: Shifted from manual 45-minute triages to sub-second automated Groq LLaMA 3.1 narrative reports.
- **Knowledge Retrieval**: Upgraded from keyword searches to FAISS & LangChain dense vector similarity RAG pipelines.
